Diarrhea after drinking alcohol ` [Highlight start] happens mainly because alcohol speeds up gut contractions and irritates the lining of your stomach and intestines, preventing your colon from absorbing enough water [Highlight end] ` . Most cases clear up on their own within 24 to 72 hours once you stop drinking and rehydrate.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXX1-n98eC5OVp2tAQUqgy8MKrArjrpOKQEFTXIx_vpaLXG4tAwkY5WYAp2PlfXwLcpxnmK0elLxqZveAV_E12g2mk796SpK7xeXbNK6p1j1wVX70XdCgyrafxoYx0PFXbLuwER-lz4N0zI545MgB5QDQbszC7_Bd8V)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXUQtH4EbbYbdrECxeVGzbKSquq71xmsSYci3NLnF4joTqI4BkDYfV_sIeW9jkqBWNVsEr7_5yAytCLFhbIOX4d_u9HN1fkQtgKzf9VJec7SfqMtI0TT7mChR74D3-IqUUgwMJciONqfRgYcDHwaf9qbwU0Kg2bTM)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF12cL6iMrEolY1vLeKXm3ity7mQbUwu0eRzKjbP8z8zi8bAq30BOxtbwrfk50fYug-EivMHCskj19DEEKvRh9VTZRsPgRCiYVj6moE12vG2blRAIJUKfVDuPB4ln59k9Q-yB4_xubXxWkli00syx4IfBkhANnR8YXhuTWQtQ)

### Why It Happens

- **Faster gut transit:** Alcohol speeds up muscle contractions in your digestive tract, pushing stool through before enough fluid is absorbed.
- **Intestinal irritation and fluid shifts:** It irritates the gut lining, triggers inflammation, and draws extra water into the bowel.
- **Gut microbiome changes:** Alcohol can disrupt the balance of helpful and harmful bacteria in your gut.
- **Drink ingredients and mixers:** Beer, sugary mixers, and sweet drinks often add carbs or sugars that worsen loose stools.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXUQtH4EbbYbdrECxeVGzbKSquq71xmsSYci3NLnF4joTqI4BkDYfV_sIeW9jkqBWNVsEr7_5yAytCLFhbIOX4d_u9HN1fkQtgKzf9VJec7SfqMtI0TT7mChR74D3-IqUUgwMJciONqfRgYcDHwaf9qbwU0Kg2bTM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXUU8LuY5u6jGbB7u8K7NyU8IMNyurfhYFyBYkI9J4DlmPsKKsEhE8dE1273dFbRBSqxuoeqAYXa2Mykt5MadnBwbCbIN4j8whZNLjeyzW1jSBQoefjqBH7zY8CTCqV46EPbbRwEL1VA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXX7H1jaTPxrfpMB3KgybuJMvKzsl5CffGDFGTBl45xh6-alrvLpsxDoiQ19IkZcRHE5po6qSmcZTAULQjQVo3e8jzCBsj13Jf2Lgyi2OXFAu0RJbAm9u6SN504UIxeaKUMNg)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF13-9QXuPzl1RUWi5I35RU6wYZ8UIrKoChYVLxgkW1I0EO5Q6my7p1KEmJSQklWh1zSp4T699EjT_l0ccU3Op8I0uqNbRUF00RYX1DveuYVLtQlCWFXIYEhweibAAkt9oNQUoSibf7A_s2X_2ETYswSRdpTfuzTCH9B4_qWlS35Ju1juxFg)

### Common Triggers and Higher-Risk Factors

- Drinking on an empty stomach or binge drinking
- Underlying digestive conditions such as irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), celiac disease, or Crohn's disease
- Lack of sleep or irregular sleep schedules
- Caffeine, dairy, or greasy foods alongside alcohol[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF16b53kW4PVqAWyW1rlsqTat_58a_l9IJ_wtGGUDREjk_bYNOiVD93tofpdpYRxkXAYWEJzLXSxMPxeRrjwuLbeD7fcinxIj2l7zyw9KykaACiaR1nEjWiueMU6N1E5__s9pzBCvCLUQ471eVQNeAUIKdehA41ryRbZPIRc8sk3ekvEBBZ1RH)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF12cL6iMrEolY1vLeKXm3ity7mQbUwu0eRzKjbP8z8zi8bAq30BOxtbwrfk50fYug-EivMHCskj19DEEKvRh9VTZRsPgRCiYVj6moE12vG2blRAIJUKfVDuPB4ln59k9Q-yB4_xubXxWkli00syx4IfBkhANnR8YXhuTWQtQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXUQtH4EbbYbdrECxeVGzbKSquq71xmsSYci3NLnF4joTqI4BkDYfV_sIeW9jkqBWNVsEr7_5yAytCLFhbIOX4d_u9HN1fkQtgKzf9VJec7SfqMtI0TT7mChR74D3-IqUUgwMJciONqfRgYcDHwaf9qbwU0Kg2bTM)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF13-9QXuPzl1RUWi5I35RU6wYZ8UIrKoChYVLxgkW1I0EO5Q6my7p1KEmJSQklWh1zSp4T699EjT_l0ccU3Op8I0uqNbRUF00RYX1DveuYVLtQlCWFXIYEhweibAAkt9oNQUoSibf7A_s2X_2ETYswSRdpTfuzTCH9B4_qWlS35Ju1juxFg)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXYmavIehXqvX0_uH1y5Po4KlhXnCIbbOAG4Wv1fuFQXHsIXL5g9JYx3BTnsQlTeiOVK6fc37g3YAPzQVe7ejUe4_-naM1I7MIoErZL2H6Tssy8lA7qlnm_P_d9z_I46NADDVFZONN)

### What to Do Now

- **Stop drinking alcohol** until your digestion returns to normal.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF16b53kW4PVqAWyW1rlsqTat_58a_l9IJ_wtGGUDREjk_bYNOiVD93tofpdpYRxkXAYWEJzLXSxMPxeRrjwuLbeD7fcinxIj2l7zyw9KykaACiaR1nEjWiueMU6N1E5__s9pzBCvCLUQ471eVQNeAUIKdehA41ryRbZPIRc8sk3ekvEBBZ1RH)
- **Replenish fluids:** Sip water, broth, or oral electrolyte solutions. Avoid caffeine and more alcohol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF198LNWmffOphwdpo-jGiGwwB5Qbn0ii7xhMIlIHiCai0594VQlosCzGtgbOhL3NDHC1iEEovPzN-10aECPprnZe696u8CI86YXNQ-yg0YEEGzq0sI5BbqUNa0pYOsY5S--AdOkdCnl_Rm-DTfQJgV0pYBmsRz-rVeZWL-Og)
- **Eat bland foods:** Try simple options like bananas, rice, applesauce, or toast, and hold off on greasy, spicy, high-fiber, or dairy foods for a bit.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXYmavIehXqvX0_uH1y5Po4KlhXnCIbbOAG4Wv1fuFQXHsIXL5g9JYx3BTnsQlTeiOVK6fc37g3YAPzQVe7ejUe4_-naM1I7MIoErZL2H6Tssy8lA7qlnm_P_d9z_I46NADDVFZONN)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF12cL6iMrEolY1vLeKXm3ity7mQbUwu0eRzKjbP8z8zi8bAq30BOxtbwrfk50fYug-EivMHCskj19DEEKvRh9VTZRsPgRCiYVj6moE12vG2blRAIJUKfVDuPB4ln59k9Q-yB4_xubXxWkli00syx4IfBkhANnR8YXhuTWQtQ)
- **Consider over-the-counter relief:** Medications like loperamide or bismuth subsalicylate may help short-term symptoms, though checking with a doctor or pharmacist is smart if you have other symptoms or health conditions. For a thorough breakdown of causes and prevention tips, see the [Cleveland Clinic](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXX1-n98eC5OVp2tAQUqgy8MKrArjrpOKQEFTXIx_vpaLXG4tAwkY5WYAp2PlfXwLcpxnmK0elLxqZveAV_E12g2mk796SpK7xeXbNK6p1j1wVX70XdCgyrafxoYx0PFXbLuwER-lz4N0zI545MgB5QDQbszC7_Bd8V).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXX1-n98eC5OVp2tAQUqgy8MKrArjrpOKQEFTXIx_vpaLXG4tAwkY5WYAp2PlfXwLcpxnmK0elLxqZveAV_E12g2mk796SpK7xeXbNK6p1j1wVX70XdCgyrafxoYx0PFXbLuwER-lz4N0zI545MgB5QDQbszC7_Bd8V)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF12cL6iMrEolY1vLeKXm3ity7mQbUwu0eRzKjbP8z8zi8bAq30BOxtbwrfk50fYug-EivMHCskj19DEEKvRh9VTZRsPgRCiYVj6moE12vG2blRAIJUKfVDuPB4ln59k9Q-yB4_xubXxWkli00syx4IfBkhANnR8YXhuTWQtQ)

### When to See a Doctor
Seek medical care if diarrhea lasts more than 2 to 3 days, or right away if you notice warning signs such as:[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF13-9QXuPzl1RUWi5I35RU6wYZ8UIrKoChYVLxgkW1I0EO5Q6my7p1KEmJSQklWh1zSp4T699EjT_l0ccU3Op8I0uqNbRUF00RYX1DveuYVLtQlCWFXIYEhweibAAkt9oNQUoSibf7A_s2X_2ETYswSRdpTfuzTCH9B4_qWlS35Ju1juxFg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXX1-n98eC5OVp2tAQUqgy8MKrArjrpOKQEFTXIx_vpaLXG4tAwkY5WYAp2PlfXwLcpxnmK0elLxqZveAV_E12g2mk796SpK7xeXbNK6p1j1wVX70XdCgyrafxoYx0PFXbLuwER-lz4N0zI545MgB5QDQbszC7_Bd8V)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXUQtH4EbbYbdrECxeVGzbKSquq71xmsSYci3NLnF4joTqI4BkDYfV_sIeW9jkqBWNVsEr7_5yAytCLFhbIOX4d_u9HN1fkQtgKzf9VJec7SfqMtI0TT7mChR74D3-IqUUgwMJciONqfRgYcDHwaf9qbwU0Kg2bTM)

- Severe abdominal or rectal pain
- Bloody or black, tarry stools
- High fever
- Signs of significant dehydration (such as dizziness, confusion, or very little urination) or unexplained weight loss[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF12cL6iMrEolY1vLeKXm3ity7mQbUwu0eRzKjbP8z8zi8bAq30BOxtbwrfk50fYug-EivMHCskj19DEEKvRh9VTZRsPgRCiYVj6moE12vG2blRAIJUKfVDuPB4ln59k9Q-yB4_xubXxWkli00syx4IfBkhANnR8YXhuTWQtQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXX1-n98eC5OVp2tAQUqgy8MKrArjrpOKQEFTXIx_vpaLXG4tAwkY5WYAp2PlfXwLcpxnmK0elLxqZveAV_E12g2mk796SpK7xeXbNK6p1j1wVX70XdCgyrafxoYx0PFXbLuwER-lz4N0zI545MgB5QDQbszC7_Bd8V)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF16b53kW4PVqAWyW1rlsqTat_58a_l9IJ_wtGGUDREjk_bYNOiVD93tofpdpYRxkXAYWEJzLXSxMPxeRrjwuLbeD7fcinxIj2l7zyw9KykaACiaR1nEjWiueMU6N1E5__s9pzBCvCLUQ471eVQNeAUIKdehA41ryRbZPIRc8sk3ekvEBBZ1RH)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF13-9QXuPzl1RUWi5I35RU6wYZ8UIrKoChYVLxgkW1I0EO5Q6my7p1KEmJSQklWh1zSp4T699EjT_l0ccU3Op8I0uqNbRUF00RYX1DveuYVLtQlCWFXIYEhweibAAkt9oNQUoSibf7A_s2X_2ETYswSRdpTfuzTCH9B4_qWlS35Ju1juxFg)

For a thorough breakdown of causes and prevention tips, see the [Cleveland Clinic](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXX1-n98eC5OVp2tAQUqgy8MKrArjrpOKQEFTXIx_vpaLXG4tAwkY5WYAp2PlfXwLcpxnmK0elLxqZveAV_E12g2mk796SpK7xeXbNK6p1j1wVX70XdCgyrafxoYx0PFXbLuwER-lz4N0zI545MgB5QDQbszC7_Bd8V).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXX1-n98eC5OVp2tAQUqgy8MKrArjrpOKQEFTXIx_vpaLXG4tAwkY5WYAp2PlfXwLcpxnmK0elLxqZveAV_E12g2mk796SpK7xeXbNK6p1j1wVX70XdCgyrafxoYx0PFXbLuwER-lz4N0zI545MgB5QDQbszC7_Bd8V)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF12cL6iMrEolY1vLeKXm3ity7mQbUwu0eRzKjbP8z8zi8bAq30BOxtbwrfk50fYug-EivMHCskj19DEEKvRh9VTZRsPgRCiYVj6moE12vG2blRAIJUKfVDuPB4ln59k9Q-yB4_xubXxWkli00syx4IfBkhANnR8YXhuTWQtQ)
